title: Photosynthesis Inputs
question: Which of the following are required inputs for photosynthesis? Select all that apply.

answers.feedback: Correct. CO<sub>2</sub> enters the leaf through stomata and is fixed in the Calvin cycle.
Correct. Water is split during the light reactions to release oxygen and electrons.
Correct. Light energy drives the light-dependent reactions in the thylakoid membrane.
Glucose is a product of photosynthesis, not an input.
Oxygen is released as a byproduct of photosynthesis, not consumed by it.
